def fourth_smallest_distinct(nums):
    """Return the fourth smallest value among the DISTINCT values of nums (duplicates count once). If nums has fewer than 4 distinct values, return None.
    >>> fourth_smallest_distinct([10, -41, -28, 12, 12, 47, 7, -49, -39, -19, -6, 9])
    -28
    >>> fourth_smallest_distinct([39, -36, 28, -6, 16, -49, -37, -5])
    -6
    >>> fourth_smallest_distinct([])
    """
